name: Introduction of Creative Questions (SSC)
description: Creative Question (CQ) system first launched in SSC for Bangla 1st Paper (2010), then expanded.
structural_impact: Discontinuity in question format. Before 2010, exams were 100% traditional essay/short questions.

name: CQ Expansion to HSC
description: Gradual rollout of Creative Questions to HSC across Bangla, ICT, and science subjects.
structural_impact: Marks distribution: Non-practical 60 CQ (6 out of 9) + 40 MCQ; Practical 50 CQ (5 out of 8) + 35 MCQ + 15 Practical.

name: Standardized Modern CQ System
description: Strict standardization: Non-practical 70 CQ (7 out of 11) + 30 MCQ; Practical 50 CQ (5 out of 8) + 25 MCQ + 25 Practical.
structural_impact: Stable period. 2018 HSC was conducted with a single uniform Combined Board Question for all boards.

name: COVID-19 Cancellation (Auto-Pass)
description: HSC 2020 was cancelled due to the pandemic; results calculated based on JSC & SSC GPA averages (JSC 25%, SSC 75%).
structural_impact: Total data gap for HSC 2020. No question papers exist.

name: COVID Short Syllabus (Group Subjects Only)
description: Exams held only on 3 elective group subjects with heavily reduced syllabus, shortened duration (1.5 hours), and greater choice (answer 2-3 out of 8).
structural_impact: Severe selection bias and shortened format; chapter inclusion was restricted to ~4-5 designated chapters.

name: Revised Condensed Syllabus
description: Re-introduced compulsory subjects, retained condensed chapter subsets (roughly 50-70% syllabus coverage).
structural_impact: Chapters outside the short syllabus had 0% probability of appearance by policy mandate.

name: Curriculum Transformation & Full Syllabus Return
description: HSC returning to full/standard syllabus; ongoing educational reform (National Curriculum Framework 2021/2024).
structural_impact: Gradual shifting of evaluation methods, requiring dynamic covariate modeling.
